decisions.reason: Validation and adoption of technical lessons within existing goals can proceed without blanket new approval; verify evidence, scope, and semantic correctness.
Technical lesson correction or revocation within existing goals is technical maintenance, not a new value or permission choice.
Publishing private role memory beyond its authorized scope changes permission and is not already authorized; do not publish absent human authorization.

remaining: Do not represent the research target as a deployed general natural-language planning or expert-routing runtime.
Run the existing local checks and inspect a bounded memory retrieval/withdrawal case; record observed behavior and limitations.
Test memory contribution against a suitable comparison before claiming benefit; measure human time before claiming time savings.
Expert discovery and cross-agent routing remain proposal questions, not demonstrated capabilities.
Do not publish private role memory outside its authorized scope without a human permission decision.
